all_source_original_claims.source_claim: Limited computational resources/time motivate metareasoning that chooses how and when to implement task-dependent cognitive control, not an observed individual brain unit
Environment presents belief-state s, action/reward contingencies, and costs; process-policies are candidates to select rather than guaranteed physical brain procedures

all_source_original_claims.locator: main PDF EVC source and S2 Eq8–9
all_source_original_claims.source_claim: Expected value of control defines candidate intensity-vector control selection maximizing expected outcome utility net implementation/reconfiguration cost

LVOC(s,c) is original approximate learned predictor with context features f_k(s), candidate continuous control intensity components, feature×control interactions, control cost and response latency opportunity cost
Model weights w encode learned approximate computational value of candidate control specifications; fixed feature basis and linear extrapolation are assumed, not empirically measured brain weights
Reward/next state and time-cost instantiate an original experience-dependent EVOC proxy, rather than treating experimenter rewards as identical to the posterior predicted control value
EVOC proxy is assumed noisy with Gaussian likelihood and weights Gaussian shrinkage prior; statistical regularization is part of proposed Bayesian learning algorithm
Posterior over control-value weights updated using original covariate design matrix and observed experience; cost/time predictors and prior precision materially shape inferred policy
Task experience couples prior belief-state, chosen candidate control, external reward, response time and next state to learned LVOC update; no claim neural implementation of exact Gaussian posterior
Source approximate Thompson-style posterior weight sampling, predicts expected value of candidate control and chooses best sampled control configuration, not observed trial-by-trial brain posterior
Value-of-computation net task performance gain versus costs motivates intensity and strategy selection/stopping when marginal expected computational benefit not worth opportunity cost

EVC optimizes parametrized continuous control signals, whereas rational VOC selects strategy maximizing expected utility net time cost; these are mathematically related but not same primitive observed phenomenon
Original EVOC theory combines discrete computational strategies with graded continuous control signals as a unified control specification problem, not extra experimentally validated neural switch

all_source_original_claims.locator: main Results and prior attention experiment
all_source_original_claims.source_claim: LVOC simulations account for learned visual attention control from published attention task behavior under its task-specific reward and time constraints
Source model simulations explain learning/transfer patterns in four interference-control experiments in pre-existing human datasets, not this paper recruiting new cohort for each source task

all_source_original_claims.locator: main variants and original model comparison
all_source_original_claims.source_claim: Comparisons with Rescorla–Wagner associative and win-stay/lose-shift alternatives favor LVOC for original selected task/fit metrics, not global superiority on every task
Model predicts training and transfer to novel task conditions from learned feature×control predictor; observed prior participants' behavior and simulated predicted policy require distinct reporting

all_source_original_claims.locator: main model source unfavorable nonlinear context
all_source_original_claims.source_claim: Feature-linearity/additive basis can predict maladaptive excess effort/self-control failure when underlying payoff is nonlinear or original candidate signals differ
Resource costs and subjective effort depend on task-specific parameterization; an ideal normative objective does not establish humans always maximize actual reward

dACC and dopamine-modulated SARSA-style synaptic plasticity are a separate plausible implementation conjecture of learned value, not fitted original cortical recordings or mathematically identical Bayesian update
Proposed SARSA-style feature-weight rule w_{t+1}=w_t+learning-rate×prediction-error×feature is a possible approximation with different learning dynamics from full Gaussian posterior

Shenhav Botvinick Cohen 2013 EVC and direct Lieder et al 2014/2015 rational strategy selection are explicit sources and combined by current learned-control model; neither architecture originated fully here

all_source_original_claims.locator: P12 official main old archived rev1 notice
all_source_original_claims.source_claim: Archived issuer rev1 explicitly uncorrected proof and not canonical original PDF used for the mathematical source freeze; no hypothetical version interchangeability

External feature/reward/time-consequence schedule and task stimuli are experimentally imposed; posterior LVOC/EVOC predictor and selected control intensity are proposed System; measured prior choice/RT outcomes are boundary outputs
Same broad PFC/EVC terms with P11/eLife/PF02/G2 working candidates do not prove same direct central mathematical model family; conditional source-native ancestry graph required

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: issuer s001 full original S1 Eqs1–7 and exact OMML
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: Distinguish external achieved reward r, predicted value of next state and measured T composing a proxy EVOC target V, learned estimated Q and posterior approximate w. A09 should not suggest source computes exact real Q* from observations without approximation.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: issuer s002 full mathematical text Eq8–13
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: The article instantiates EVC continuous controls and VOC strategy selection but has no demonstrated dedicated sequential neural stopping procedure. Cost–benefit criterion is normative selection under bounded time; narrow A11 to the paper's candidate selection, not literal empirically proven stopping dynamics.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: published original Eq6, Fig4 and original source scope
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: Original linear feature/control interaction basis and fitted opportunity cost are model assumptions; source-specific nonlinear context failure not a general proof that every nonlinearity causes overexertion.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: original Results five pre-existing datasets, original comparison methods
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: Existing human visual-attention and interference tasks reanalyzed and fit with paper's simulation are not five freshly collected experiments; comparison RW/WSLS task-matched and source-specific, no assertion universal superior.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: source-author titled issuer S3 'Speculations ... implementation in brain' full text and exact Eq1/2
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: The S3 candidate dACC SARSA rule is hypothetical and an approximation distinct from the main Gaussian posterior inference. Claiming measured dACC dopamine neural learning would be fabrication.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: source issuer s002 original bibliography references1–4 and G1 original papers
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: Direct explicit intellectual EVC/VOC lineage proven, but overlap P11 gating, eLife cue/history joint model and PF02/G2 working CTL cannot be decided by concept vocabulary alone.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: published main formal model and task design
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: External task rewards/RT are measured inputs; source predicted LVOC, sampling weights and inferred values are unobserved latent model; preserve System/World/Experiment/observation split.

source_specific_B_challenges.source_specific_original: publisher canonical article old rev1 UNCORRECTED PROOF warning
source_specific_B_challenges.objection: Do not equate printed original canonical full PDF with archived rev1 proof, do not infer all correction history absent without independent external registry proof.
